_comment: RoboLab Verified P79 -- the 'realistic' friction preset. Coulomb coefficients per
object catalog class (assets/objects/object_catalog.json, field 'class'). Values are
the surface's own coefficient; PhysX combines pad and object with the *average*
rule, so the effective pad-object coefficient is (gripper + class) / 2 -- e.g.
0.8 + 0.4 -> 0.6. Numbers are engineering-table values for the dominant material of
each class against dry rubber, rounded to one decimal and deliberately on the high
side of the published ranges, because rigid PhysX contacts have no pad compliance.
'default' is used for classes not listed and for objects the catalog does not know.
'gripper' is applied to the robot's friction_bodies (the finger pads).
Each entry is {static, dynamic} or a single number for both.
